0022600213.text: The Phoenix Suns (3-6, 3-3 at home) host the LA Clippers (2-7) in the Suns' 10th game of the season, with Phoenix coming off a loss, sitting 12th in the West and 5.5 games back in the Pacific, while the Clippers are 13th in the West and 6.5 back. Phoenix is without Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Mark Williams (shoulder surgery), while the Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), and Cam Christie is day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet this season, though they split their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the last meeting was on February 1, 2026 in Phoenix, when the Suns lost 117-93.
